step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a continuous-time linear equalizer (CTLE) or feedforward equalizer stage. It uses two parallel differential pairs (one acting as the main path, the other as a subtractive/high-frequency path) whose outputs are summed at a single-ended push-pull output stage to provide adjustable high-frequency peaking.

paper_reference.title: A 20Gb/s Adaptive Equalizer in 0.13µm CMOS Technology

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the equalizer.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain is determined by gm_in / gm_load. With all transistors sized equally (W/L = 5µm/0.5µm), the intrinsic gain of each stage is roughly 1 (0 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The unoptimized uniform sizing in the extracted netlist will yield much lower gain than the 20dB reported in the paper, which used optimized dimensions.

peak_gain.description: Maximum voltage gain across the frequency spectrum, indicating the boost level.

sky130_expected.calculation: Peak gain occurs where the feedforward zero kicks in before the parasitic poles roll off the response.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias currents (N0, N8) which control the relative weights of the two paths.

bw_3db.description: The frequency at which the gain drops by 3dB from its peak value.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB ≈ 1 / (2 * pi * R_load * C_parasitic). With L=0.5µm, the parasitic capacitances are relatively large.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 0.5µm channel length in the netlist is much slower than the 0.13µm process used in the paper, reducing the bandwidth significantly from 10GHz.

power.description: Total static power consumption of the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. Two tail currents + output stage current. Assuming ~1mA per branch at 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard biasing for 5µm/0.5µm devices will draw a few milliamps total.

delay.description: Propagation delay from the differential input crossing to the output crossing.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Slower 0.5µm devices will result in a longer propagation delay compared to the 28.4ps reported for 0.13µm.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC frequency response (gain, peaking, bandwidth), and transient propagation delay of the adaptive equalizer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Adaptive Equalizer Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized W/L
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N6 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 N9 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N11 N1 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N12 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N11 N11 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N9 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 N1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N5 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N2 N10 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N8 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N9 N9 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N5 N7 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Bias Voltages (Controls equalization weight)
VBIAS1 N0 0 0.7
VBIAS2 N8 0 0.6

* Input Signals (Common mode 1.2V, 10GHz clock for Tran)
VINP N1 0 dc 1.2 ac 0.5 pulse(1.1 1.3 0 10p 10p 40p 100p)
VINM1 N10 0 dc 1.2 ac -0.5 pulse(1.3 1.1 0 10p 10p 40p 100p)
VINM2 N7 0 dc 1.2 ac -0.5 pulse(1.3 1.1 0 10p 10p 40p 100p)

* Load Capacitance
CL N6 0 10f

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power_watts = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power_watts

  * 2. AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(N6)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(max_gain-3) fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 300p
  meas tran t_delay trig v(N1) val=1.2 rise=1 targ v(N6) val=0.9 cross=1

  quit
.endc
.end
